get.description: Read a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying the properties you want to include in the response. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to retrieve associated object IDs and archived records.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and receive a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint allows for the creation of standard objects, with documentation and examples provided to assist in the process.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This operation moves the specified objects to the recycling bin, effectively archiving them. Use this endpoint to manage large sets of objects that need to be archived simultaneously.

Create a batch of CRM objects with specified properties in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, making it efficient for bulk operations. The response includes the created objects along with their IDs. Use this endpoint to streamline the creation of large datasets within your CRM.

Read a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows you to retrieve multiple objects in a single request, which is useful for efficiently gathering data on a set of objects. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects at once by providing their details in the request body. It is useful for bulk updates where you need to change properties for several objects simultaneously. The response will include the status of each update operation.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by their unique property values. This endpoint allows for efficient management of multiple objects in a single request, ensuring that each object is either created or updated based on the provided unique identifiers.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties of the specified objects into a single object, retaining the primary object's ID. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify data under a single object.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to perform complex queries to find objects that match specific conditions. It returns a collection of objects that meet the search criteria, along with the total count of results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object, effectively removing it from active use while retaining it in the system for potential recovery or auditing purposes.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

post.description: Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations.
